title: Lab 2D part 2 — Lambda stats uploader → Aurora

answers.explanation: Lambda is a client — outbound to writer :5432. No inbound listeners on lambda-stats-sg (Night 16 Q14 callback).
INSERT/UPSERT uses cluster writer endpoint. Night 16 Q6 — reader is for read replicas.
VPC Lambda cold start includes ENI create/attach in private subnets — plan timeout ≥ 30s.
Secrets Manager for rotation/audit; avoid plaintext DB passwords in env vars (Night 15/17 pattern).
SQS visibility timeout ≥ Lambda timeout — message reappears if processing exceeds visibility.
Study lab maps Iceland ECS completion → default IS-001 UPSERT; production would parse metadata.
Private subnet Lambdas need NAT or VPC endpoints for AWS API egress — Night 9 NAT pattern.
GSA split from Night 15/16 — DynamoDB counters vs Aurora relational JOIN reports.
RDS Proxy pools connections for many concurrent Lambdas — Night 15 theory.
Lab teaches VPC + SG + TCP PostgreSQL path tested on SAA; Data API is alternate (Night 16 init).
RDS Data API over HTTPS from laptop; Lambda uses in-VPC TCP — both valid, different paths.
Night 17 teardown is Lambda-only; Night 13 SQS/EventBridge unaffected by Aurora teardown.
Standard SQS at-least-once — idempotent UPSERT handles duplicate delivery safely.
DynamoDB for hot wiki counters; SQS-decoupled Lambda persists batch stats to Aurora.
IAM role propagation delay common after create-role — sleep/retry before VPC Lambda create.
